svg.title: Retrograde loops from a deferent and an epicycle
svg.desc: Apparent paths of a planet on a deferent circle and an epicycle for four ratios of epicycle tip speed to deferent speed; retrograde stretches in red.
svg.text: Retrograde motion: the epicycle outruns the deferent
ratio = r w_e / (R w_d); Earth at the centre, deferent R = 1 (grey); red where the apparent longitude falls
